metadata.family: Operator-built privilege-escalation and AD tooling around the CyberStrikeAI penetration-testing agent platform (INV-2026-080)
metadata.notes: Operator-side values only: the operator's server, operator-built files, and the operator's own labels. Victim values are not in this feed. Stock public tools are marked STOCK and carry action HUNT; their hashes match anyone using the public tool. Execution of the operator-built files on any victim is not shown by any held file.

The operator served it on port 8090 and fetched it with certutil. The same file hash is a widely circulating from-source build, first seen by VirusTotal on 2024-10-07 and submitted 198 times from 178 sources, so it identifies the public file and anyone who holds it, not this operator's own build.

ipv4.purpose: Operator server: open directory (745 files listed by Vantage)
ipv4.notes: Vultr (The Constant Company, AS20473) commercial hosting address in 199.247.0.0/19. Caveats before blocking: the address served unrelated tenants in 2019 to 2021 and 2023 to 2024, and whether the operator rented this instance or compromised it is INSUFFICIENT, so a block can fall on an innocent owner or a future tenant; time-box any block and re-check the address first. Ports 8081 (HTTP 404 on 2026-10-07) and 8090 (tool staging: chisel, dnsplugin.dll) also seen.
ipv4.false_positive_note: Shared commercial hosting. The address has had other tenants and may be reassigned; the instance may belong to a third party. Do not treat as a permanent block.

hunt_only_never_block.context: Passive DNS (VirusTotal) shows an A record from this name to the case IP, TTL 300, last modified 2026-10-07, inside a set of country-labelled .ir hostnames that all point to different hosts and look like a VPN or proxy node fleet. A scan-history export scoped to the apex domain did not show the record, which neither confirms nor contradicts the passive-DNS result; Whether the workbench operator runs that fleet, rents a node in it or only shares an address with it is not established: LOW as a link to the operator. The directory on :8000 was first seen 2026-09-26. The record's first appearance is not known; its last-modified date is 7 October 2026. The address has had other tenants. Context only, do not block.
hunt_only_never_block.false_positive_note: Possible third-party service. Never block on this alone
hunt_only_never_block.source: Passive DNS (VirusTotal) and a scan-history export, as described in the context
